mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the exact-count constraint on audit events per application status. The injected violation forces a Submitted application to carry zero audit events, violating AppendOnly (which requires exactly 1 event for Submitted) and FR_019_ExactlyOneAuditPerTransition.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = Submitted and #{ e: ApplicationEvent | e.forApp = a } = 0 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the requirement that a terminal application has a corresponding UnderReview→Approved/Rejected audit event. The injection forces an Approved application to exist without any such event, violating AuditCompleteness and FR_015_AtomicDecisionAudit.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditDecisionMissing { some a: LoanApplication | a.status = Approved and no e: ApplicationEvent | (e.forApp = a and e.prevStatus = UnderReview and e.newStatus = Approved) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission matrix fact allows Alloy to assign any set of permissions. The injection adds ComplianceReviewer→PostDecision to the Allowed set, directly violating LeastPrivilege, FR_004_ComplianceReadOnly, and FR_023_ComplianceReadOnlyEnforced.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { ComplianceReviewer -> PostDecision in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the constraint that the deciding officer equals the assigned officer. The injection creates an application where the decision is recorded by a different LoanOfficer than the one assigned, violating FR_013_OnlyAssignedOfficerDecides.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongDecider { some a: LoanApplication | some a.appDecision and a.appDecision.decidedBy != a.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the uniqueness constraint on in-flight applications per customer. The injection forces two distinct applications owned by the same customer to both be in-flight simultaneously, directly violating FR_008_OneInFlight.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlight { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.owner = a2.owner and a1.status = Submitted and a2.status = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows events with any prevStatus/newStatus combination. The injection creates an audit event whose prevStatus is Approved, representing an illegal transition out of a terminal state, violating FR_016_TerminalStateImmutable and FR_009_ValidStateMachine.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TransitionFromTerminal { some e: ApplicationEvent | e.prevStatus = Approved and e.newStatus = Rejected }
